content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Gorakhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Gorakhpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for AIIMS Gorakhpur is scheduled for 20 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by AIIMS Gorakhpur for the Project Technical Support II and Project Technical Support positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for Project Technical Support II?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for Project Technical Support II is 12th in science with a Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering or equivalent) and five years of experience, or a three-year Graduate degree with two years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Project Technical Support posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Project Technical Support II is 30 years, and for Project Technical Support, it is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Technical Support II is Rs. 20,000 + HRA, and for Project Technical Support, it is Rs. 28,000 + HRA, as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for AIIMS Gorakhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Gorakhpur (AIIMS Gorakhpur), Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: These are project-based positions, indicating they are for a specific project duration and may be contractual in nature.
